show sunday
scene makidrive1
: Sensei?...
lines.zh: : Sensei?……

lines.en: : I’m sorry to wake you up so early, but...
lines.zh: : 抱歉这么早把你叫醒,不过……

lines.en: : There’s a stranger in our house.
lines.zh: : 我们家有个陌生人。

lines.en: scene black
: I’m going back to sleep.
lines.zh: : 我要回去睡了。

lines.en: : You’re going to leave me to die just like that?!
lines.zh: : 你就这么把我丢下等死吗?!

lines.en: scene makidrive2
: Ami, if there was an actual stranger in our house, I know for a fact you wouldn’t be calmly discussing it with me after gently waking me up.
lines.zh: : Ami,如果家里真有陌生人,我敢肯定你不会先温柔地把我叫醒,再心平气和地跟我讨论这件事。

lines.en: : Okay...So maybe it isn’t a {i}stranger{/i} per se, but it’s still someone who shouldn’t be here!
lines.zh: : 好吧……也许严格来说算不上「{i}陌生人{/i}」,但那也是不该出现在这儿的人!

lines.en: : Then tell them to go home. I’m tired.
lines.zh: : 那就让她回家。我困了。

lines.en: : I tried! But she walked right past me and poured herself a cup of coffee that I made for {i}you{/i} and then sat down on the couch like she owned the place!
lines.zh: : 我试过了!可她直接从我身边走过去,倒了一杯我给{i}你{/i}泡的咖啡,然后一屁股坐在沙发上,像这是她家一样!

lines.en: : Ugh...who is it then? Noriko? Ayane?
lines.zh: : 呃……那是谁?Noriko?Ayane?

lines.en: : It’s that frickin’ lube dealer again! And she didn’t even bring any samples this time!
lines.zh: : 又是那个该死的润滑油贩子!而且这次她连样品都没带!

lines.en: Maki?
lines.zh: Maki?

lines.en: She’s {i}here?{/i}
lines.zh: 她{i}在这儿{/i}?

lines.en: : If it’s her...I’ll be up in a second. I just need to get dressed.
lines.zh: : 如果是她……我马上就起来。我得先穿好衣服。

lines.en: scene makidrive3
: What do you mean, “{i}If it’s her?”{/i} How the heck am I supposed to interpret that?
lines.zh: : 「{i}如果是她{/i}」是什么意思?你让我怎么理解这句话?

lines.en: : You can interpret it by making more coffee since Maki has apparently taken mine.
lines.zh: : 你可以这么理解:再去泡点咖啡,因为 Maki 显然把我那杯抢走了。

lines.en: scene makidrive4
: Fine! But only because I love you and would do whatever you tell me, no matter what it is.
lines.zh: : 好吧!但这只是因为我爱你,而且不管你说什么我都照做,无论是什么事。

lines.en: : I’m aware. Thanks, Ami.
lines.zh: : 我知道。谢了,Ami。

lines.en: scene black
Ami leaves the room and I bring myself to my feet, throwing on the shirt Molly made for me- a shirt that was neatly folded by my “beloved” niece and placed on my desk sometime this morning.
lines.zh: Ami 离开房间,我撑起身子,套上 Molly 给我做的那件衬衫——它被我「亲爱的」侄女叠得整整齐齐,今早不知什么时候放在了我桌上。

lines.en: If Maki’s here, it can really only mean one of two things.
lines.zh: 如果 Maki 在这儿,那基本只可能是两种情况之一。

lines.en: Either the conversation she had with Sara yesterday dramatically failed and she has nowhere else to turn to-
lines.zh: 要么她昨天和 Sara 的那场谈话彻底失败,她已经无处可去——

lines.en: Or it {i}didn’t{/i} fail. And she just needs my help with Makoto again because she can’t figure out how to believe in herself as a parent.
lines.zh: 要么它{i}没{/i}失败。而她只是又需要我帮她处理 Makoto 的事,因为她不知道该怎么相信自己是个合格的家长。

lines.en: I’m not sure why that would cause her to believe in {i}me,{/i} a significantly worse “parent,” but if she’s already here, I shouldn’t keep her waiting.
lines.zh: 我不明白这为什么会让她转而相信{i}我{/i}这个糟糕得多的「家长」,不过既然她已经来了,我就不该让她等着。

lines.en: Especially since every second I spend not supervising Ami when she’s near her increases Maki’s chance of being poisoned.
lines.zh: 尤其是,Ami 在她身边时我少盯一秒,Maki 被下毒的概率就多一分。

lines.en: scene makidrive5
: Morning. Do you always sleep this late?
lines.zh: : 早上好。你平时都睡到这么晚?

lines.en: : It’s like 8:00 AM.
lines.zh: : 现在才早上八点啊。

lines.en: : I know. I just figured I’d try making a joke that isn’t depressing, dark, or sexual. Which is probably why it didn’t come out very funny.
lines.zh: : 我知道。我只是想试着开个既不压抑、不阴暗、也不带颜色的玩笑。大概正因为这样,它才一点也不好笑。

lines.en: : While I admire the effort, I {i}would{/i} like to know what you’re doing here.
lines.zh: : 我很欣赏你的努力,不过我{i}还是想{/i}知道你来这儿干什么。

lines.en: : Not even going to {i}try{/i} waking up first? Just gonna jump straight to business?
lines.zh: : 连{i}试着{/i}清醒一下都不肯?直接就谈正事?

lines.en: : Sit down. Have a cup of coffee. Take your time. I’m in no rush.
lines.zh: : 坐下。喝杯咖啡。慢慢来。我不急。

lines.en: scene makidrive6
: You {i}drank{/i} his coffee. Now I have to brew more since {i}somebody{/i} doesn’t have any manners.
lines.zh: : 你把他的咖啡{i}喝了{/i}。现在我得再泡一壶,因为{i}某人{/i}一点礼貌都没有。

lines.en: : While you’re at it, would you mind making some more for me as well? I’ve been up since 4:00 AM, so I can kind of use it.
lines.zh: : 顺便的话,你能不能也给我再泡点?我凌晨四点就醒了,确实需要。

lines.en: : Would you like me to add a little something to it that will help you sleep better tonight? {i}Much{/i} better?
lines.zh: : 要不要我在里面加点什么东西,好让你今晚睡得{i}更{/i}香?香得多?

lines.en: Okay. So, apparently supervising Ami won’t stop her from trying to poison Maki either. That’s...good to know.
lines.zh: 好吧。看来就算我盯着 Ami,也拦不住她想毒死 Maki。这……倒是挺有用的信息。

lines.en: : Ami, don’t poison our house guests please.
lines.zh: : Ami,别给咱们的客人下毒,拜托。

lines.en: scene makidrive7
: You never let me do anything fun anymore!
lines.zh: : 你再也不让我做任何好玩的事了!

lines.en: : Thanks for looking out for me. I roofied myself once just to see what it was like and, honestly? It’s not really all it's cracked up to be.
lines.zh: : 谢谢替我操心。我以前为了尝尝是什么感觉,给自己下过一次迷药,说实话?真没传闻中那么带劲。

lines.en: : I...don’t think that’s a thing people really “crack up” to be all that exciting.
lines.zh: : 我……觉得那东西本来也没被「吹」得多带劲。

lines.en: scene makidrive8
Ami returns to the kitchen, giving me an opportunity to press a little further about Maki’s reason for coming.
lines.zh: Ami 回了厨房,我也得以趁机再追问一下 Maki 此行的目的。

lines.en: : Want to go for a drive?
lines.zh: : 想不想开车出去兜一圈?

lines.en: But before I can even ask, she opens her mouth and says that.
lines.zh: 可我还没来得及开口,她就先张嘴说了这句话。

lines.en: : Depends. Are you so deeply distressed that you’re going to drive us off a cliff?
lines.zh: : 那得看情况。你是痛苦到了要开车带我们冲下悬崖的地步吗?

lines.en: : No. But I {i}will{/i} drive at least 20 mph over the speed limit and make plenty of rolling stops.
lines.zh: : 不是。但我{i}会{/i}至少超速 20 英里,还会一路滑行通过好几个停车标志。

lines.en: : You’re lucky Kumon-mi uses American measurement systems or I wouldn’t even know how fast that is.
lines.zh: : 幸好 Kumon-mi 用的是美制单位,不然我根本不知道那有多快。

lines.en: : And you’re lucky that the roads aren’t busy this early in the morning. Rolling stops are dangerous.
lines.zh: : 而你也该庆幸一大早路上车不多。滑行通过停车标志很危险。

lines.en: scene makidrive9
: Especially when-
lines.zh: : 尤其是在——

lines.en: : Talk about something else.
lines.zh: : 换个话题。

lines.en: scene makidrive10
: Hm? Did I miss something?
lines.zh: : 嗯?我是不是漏了什么?

lines.en: : No.
lines.zh: : 没有。

lines.en: scene makidrive11
: Got it.
lines.zh: : 明白了。

lines.en: : Anyway, as I was saying, you’re coming with me. I’ve got a {i}little{/i} bit of a problem I could use your help with.
lines.zh: : 总之,我刚才说了,你得跟我走。我有个{i}小{/i}麻烦,想让你帮个忙。

lines.en: : Does that problem wear glasses and get straight A’s?
lines.zh: : 那个麻烦是不是戴眼镜、门门全 A?

lines.en: : Usually. Right now? Not really.
lines.zh: : 通常是。现在嘛?不太是。

lines.en: : Does this have something to do with Makoto getting called to the office the other day?
lines.zh: : 这跟前几天 Makoto 被叫去办公室有关吗?

lines.en: : Because if she’s been starting trouble, I don’t know if I’ll feel safe in class anymore.
lines.zh: : 因为如果她开始惹麻烦了,我不知道自己在教室里还能不能安心。

lines.en: : As the class president, she should be-
lines.zh: : 作为班长,她应该——

lines.en: : Knock it off, Ami.
lines.zh: : 少来了,Ami。

lines.en: scene makidrive12
: I was only kidding this time!
lines.zh: : 这次我只是开玩笑!

lines.en: : Makoto’s fine. We’re just having some family problems right now.
lines.zh: : Makoto 很好。我们只是现在有点家庭问题。

lines.en: scene makidrive13
: Family problems?...
lines.zh: : 家庭问题?……

lines.en: : It’s nothing you need to worry about.
lines.zh: : 这不需要你操心。

lines.en: : Ami?
lines.zh: : Ami?

lines.en: scene makidrive14
: Oh! Umm...
: Coffee!
lines.zh: : 咖啡!

lines.en: : I’ll...be right back.
lines.zh: : 我……马上回来。

lines.en: scene black
Strangely enough, Ami retreats to her room without being told after bringing the two of us a fresh pot of coffee.
lines.zh: 说来奇怪,Ami 给我们俩端来一壶新咖啡之后,不用人支使就自己回了房间。

lines.en: I guess saying “strangely enough” is a little...dismissive, though. Especially when it’s likely that she’s in the early stages of putting two and two together.
lines.zh: 不过我觉得,「说来奇怪」这个说法有点……太轻描淡写了。尤其是她很可能已经在慢慢把两件事拼到一起了。

lines.en: But while I wish I could stick around and see firsthand just what that dramatic realization does to her, I have been given a job.
lines.zh: 虽然我很想留下来亲眼看看那个戏剧性的领悟会对她造成什么影响,可我已经被派了活。

lines.en: I am not sure if it is a job that I can handle...nor a job I even {i}want,{/i} but Maki’s assertion (Combined with her exceedingly flattering soccer mom getup) forces me to come along regardless of what I want.
lines.zh: 我不确定这活我能不能干……也不确定这是不是我{i}想{/i}干的活,但 Maki 的坚持(再配上她那身格外「好看」的足球妈妈装束),逼得我不管愿不愿意都得跟来。

lines.en: And before I know it, I find myself in the passenger seat of a car- checking three times to make sure my seatbelt is buckled.
lines.zh: 而等我回过神来,我已经坐在了副驾驶座上——检查了三次安全带有没有扣好。

lines.en: scene makidrive15
: Are you nervous?
lines.zh: : 你紧张吗?

lines.en: : About what? Seeing Makoto?
lines.zh: : 紧张什么?见 Makoto?

lines.en: : About anything. You’ve been biting your nails and staring out of the window ever since I started the car.
lines.zh: : 什么都行。从我发动车开始,你就一直在咬指甲、盯着窗外。

lines.en: : My driving isn’t {i}that{/i} bad, is it?
lines.zh: : 我开车没{i}那么{/i}烂吧?

lines.en: : Your driving’s fine. I didn’t even realize I was acting strangely.
lines.zh: : 你开得挺好的。我都没意识到自己表现得很怪。

lines.en: : I don’t know. Maybe I {i}am{/i} nervous about seeing Makoto. But it would be a more...subconscious thing than me actively going over it in my head.
lines.zh: : 我也不知道。也许我{i}确实{/i}为见 Makoto 而紧张。不过那更像是一种……下意识的东西,而不是我在脑子里翻来覆去想着的事。

lines.en: : Cheering people up isn’t really one of my specialties.
lines.zh: : 逗人开心实在不算我的专长。

lines.en: : Yeah, that’s one of many things we have in common. And probably the most boring and depressing out of all of them as well.
lines.zh: : 是啊,这是我们众多共同点中的一个。而且大概也是其中最无聊、最让人沮丧的一个。

lines.en: : So, how is she doing exactly? And...better question, what do you want {i}me{/i} to do about it?
lines.zh: : 那么,她现在到底怎么样?还有……更好的问题是,你到底想让{i}我{/i}做什么?

lines.en: : I’m pretty sure she hasn’t left her room since I took her home on Friday. But I was out for a good portion of the day yesterday, so I guess it’s possible she got up to use the bathroom or something.
lines.zh: : 我基本可以肯定,从周五我把她带回家之后,她就没出过房间。不过昨天我外出了大半天,所以我想她有可能起来上过厕所什么的。

lines.en: : I really hope so.
lines.zh: : 我真希望是这样。

lines.en: : I’m surprised you felt comfortable leaving her, though. I figured you’d be attached at the hip right now.
lines.zh: : 不过我挺意外你放心把她一个人留下。我还以为你们现在会形影不离。

lines.en: : To be completely honest, I’m pretty sure that would just make things worse for her.
lines.zh: : 说实话,我敢肯定那样只会让她的状况更糟。

lines.en: : Miku’s been staying over, though. And at least Makoto doesn’t try to keep {i}her{/i} away.
lines.zh: : 不过 Miku 一直在她那儿过夜。而且至少 Makoto 没有把{i}她{/i}推开。

lines.en: : I dropped her off back at the dorm this morning. Poor girl’s gotten less sleep than both of us.
lines.zh: : 我今天早上把她送回了宿舍。那可怜的孩子比我们俩睡得都少。

lines.en: if kirinkill == False:
: Yeah, well...
lines.zh: : 是啊,嗯……

lines.en: : I think we both probably know why.
lines.zh: : 我想我们俩大概都知道为什么。

lines.en: scene makidrive16
: I mean...{i}I{/i} know why. Do {i}you{/i} know why?
lines.zh: : 我是说……{i}我{/i}知道为什么。{i}你{/i}知道为什么吗?

lines.en: : I know enough about her past to piece it together. I just don’t really know the specifics.
lines.zh: : 我对她的过去了解得够多,能拼出个大概。只是具体细节我不太清楚。

lines.en: scene makidrive15
: Huh.
: You two are closer than I thought.
lines.zh: : 你们俩比我想象的更亲近。

lines.en: : Miku doesn’t normally share that with people she doesn’t completely trust.
lines.zh: : Miku 通常不会把这些事告诉她不完全信任的人。

lines.en: : To be fair, I didn’t exactly learn it from {i}her.{/i}
lines.zh: : 说句公道话,我也不是从{i}她{/i}那儿听来的。

lines.en: : At the risk of harboring a vendetta against whoever told you, I’m going to suggest that we cut this conversation short and just...leave it at our mutual understanding of Miku’s sadness.
lines.zh: : 冒着对告诉你的人怀恨在心的风险,我建议我们就此打住……就停在我们对 Miku 的悲伤都心知肚明这一点上。

lines.en: : That girl’s been through enough. Talking about this without her knowing just doesn’t sit right with me.
lines.zh: : 那孩子已经经历得够多了。背着她谈这些,我总觉得不对劲。

lines.en: : Fair enough. I wasn’t trying to get the details out of {i}you{/i} or anything.
lines.zh: : 说得也是。我也没想从{i}你{/i}这儿套出什么细节。

lines.en: : If Miku trusts you, she’ll tell you. That’s really all you need to know.
lines.zh: : 如果 Miku 信任你,她会告诉你的。你只需要知道这个就够了。

lines.en: else:
: She really cares about Makoto, doesn’t she?
lines.zh: : 她真的很在乎 Makoto,对吧?

lines.en: : Yeah...
lines.zh: : 是啊……

lines.en: : Yeah, she does.
lines.zh: : 嗯,她很在乎。

lines.en: Maki goes back to focusing on the road as a long and uncomfortable silence emerges from the backseat of her car and crawls its way onto the center console.
lines.zh: Maki 重新把注意力放回路上,一段漫长而令人不适的沉默从她车子的后座爬了出来,一路爬到了中控台上。

lines.en: In this abrupt, unwelcome separation comes the realization that I am biting off much more than I can chew right now.
lines.zh: 就在这场突兀又不受欢迎的抽离中,我意识到自己正在贪多嚼不烂。

lines.en: That realization grows and festers with every passing stoplight, infecting my body and liquefying my teeth to the point where I can no longer bite anything.
lines.zh: 这份意识随着每一个掠过的红绿灯不断膨胀、溃烂,感染我的身体,把我的牙齿都泡软了,软到我再也咬不动任何东西。

lines.en: It doesn’t make a difference whether or not Maki intends to drive us off a cliff when I started falling to my death the moment I checked my seatbelt for the third time.
lines.zh: Maki 到底想不想开车冲下悬崖已经不重要了——因为在我第三次检查安全带的那一刻,我就已经开始坠落了。

lines.en: I want this car to turn around.
lines.zh: 我希望这辆车掉头。

lines.en: I want the suffering to end without my intervention- because if there is anything I have learned over my time here, it is that the past repeats itself.
lines.zh: 我希望这份痛苦能在我插手之前就结束——因为如果说我在这里学到了什么,那就是过去会不断重演。

lines.en: And that if my ways of handling Makoto were even the slightest bit successful, I wouldn’t have to keep fixing her.
lines.zh: 而且如果我处理 Makoto 的方式哪怕有一点点成效,我也不必一次次地去修补她。

lines.en: : You’re doing it again.
lines.zh: : 你又来了。

lines.en: : Doing what?
lines.zh: : 什么又来了?

lines.en: : Biting your nails.
lines.zh: : 咬指甲。

lines.en: : You should stop. It’s gross.
lines.zh: : 你该停了。好恶心。

lines.en: scene black
Maki continues driving, twenty miles per hour over the speed limit on almost every street we take.
lines.zh: Maki 继续开着车,几乎每条街都超速二十英里。

lines.en: But she stops at every stop sign.
lines.zh: 但她在每一个停车标志前都停住了。

lines.en: scene makidrive17
: So, uhh...do you mind if I get mildly sappy for a minute or two before I take you up to see Makoto?
lines.zh: : 那么,呃……在我带你上去见 Makoto 之前,介意我先伤感个一两分钟吗?

lines.en: : Take as long as you like because I still have no idea what I’m going to say to her.
lines.zh: : 你想多久都行,因为我到现在也不知道该对她说什么。

lines.en: : I mean...I don’t think you really need to say {i}anything.{/i} It’s not like I expect you to go up there and be like, “Hey, Makoto. Sorry your dad’s dead. Feel better now.”
lines.zh: : 我是说……我觉得你其实{i}什么{/i}都不用说。我总不至于指望你上去就说:「嘿,Makoto。很遗憾你爸死了。现在好点了吗。」

lines.en: : She just...
lines.zh: : 她只是……

lines.en: : I don’t know. I keep wanting to say this is something I should be able to handle on my own, but...the more I think about it, the more I realize that might be the exact problem.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。我一直想说这事我应该自己能扛下来,可是……我越想越觉得,也许这本身恰恰就是问题所在。

lines.en: : Makoto can’t see {i}me{/i} without also seeing her father. And it’s that constant reminder that I think is making this so hard for her.
lines.zh: : Makoto 一看到{i}我{/i},就会同时看到她父亲。而我想,正是这种不断的提醒,才让这件事对她这么难。

lines.en: : So...serious question. Do you think she can see {i}me{/i} without seeing her father?
lines.zh: : 那么……认真问一句。你觉得她看到{i}我{/i}的时候,能不看到她父亲吗?

lines.en: scene makidrive18
: I think...
lines.zh: : 我觉得……

lines.en: : Okay. So, you’re obviously the only male authority figure left in her life now. And one that she admires greatly.
lines.zh: : 好吧。显然,你是现在她生命里仅剩的男性权威形象了。而且还是她非常仰慕的一个。

lines.en: : But even with that, I don’t think she’ll ever see you as anything more than her teacher or...maybe a schoolgirl crush.
lines.zh: : 但即便如此,我觉得她眼里你也不会超出「老师」的范畴,或者……也许是女学生那种暗恋对象。

lines.en: I think it’s a lot more than just a {i}crush{/i} at this point...
lines.zh: 我觉得到了现在,这已经远不只是{i}暗恋{/i}了……

lines.en: : That girl just...does better with people like you than people like me. It’s a respect thing.
lines.zh: : 那孩子就是……跟你这样的人相处比跟我这样的人相处要好。这是尊重的问题。

lines.en: : Like, how is she going to be consoled by someone she automatically associates sex jokes and dildos with?
lines.zh: : 你想啊,她怎么会接受一个让她下意识就联想到色情笑话和假阳具的人的安慰?

lines.en: : Each time I try to hold her hand, she’s probably thinking “Wow, this hand has touched so many sex toys.”
lines.zh: : 每次我试图握住她的手,她大概都在想:「哇,这只手摸过那么多性玩具。」

lines.en: : I haven’t seen Makoto since Friday, but I’m pretty sure that is not what she’d be thinking.
lines.zh: : 我从周五起就没见过 Makoto,但我敢肯定她不会那么想。

lines.en: scene makidrive19
: I don’t {i}know{/i} what she’d be thinking, though. I {i}never{/i} know what she’s thinking because her brain is on another level than mine.
lines.zh: : 可我不{i}知道{/i}她会想什么。我{i}从来{/i}不知道她在想什么,因为她的脑子跟我不在一个层级。

lines.en: : She’s stubborn. She needs someone on the {i}same{/i} level as her to talk to or she’s just going to keep circling the drain.
lines.zh: : 她很倔。她需要一个跟她{i}同{/i}层级的人来跟她说话,否则她只会一直在下水道口打转。

lines.en: : With all due respect, I think Makoto is several levels above me as well.
lines.zh: : 恕我直言,我觉得 Makoto 也比我高好几个层级。

lines.en: : She might be. But I don’t think she sees it that way.
lines.zh: : 也许是吧。但我不觉得她是这么看的。

lines.en: : To her, you’re a role model. Someone she aspires to be. Someone she’ll actually {i}listen{/i} to because you’re not just a joke to her.
lines.zh: : 对她来说,你是个榜样。是她想成为的那种人。是她真的会{i}听进去{/i}的人,因为你对她而言不只是一个笑话。

lines.en: : You’re not {i}me.{/i}
lines.zh: : 你不是{i}我{/i}。

lines.en: scene makidrive20
: Oh, and if you’re having second thoughts about this, I’m not giving you a ride home. I am out of other options and turning to you is pretty much my last ditch effort.
lines.zh: : 对了,如果你现在反悔了,我可不会送你回家。我已经没有别的办法了,找你帮忙基本就是我最后的挣扎。

lines.en: : Have you considered {i}time?{/i}
lines.zh: : 你考虑过「{i}时间{/i}」这个选项吗?

lines.en: scene makidrive21
: Well, obviously! But time alone doesn’t cure anything when it feels like the walls are closing in around you.
lines.zh: : 当然考虑过!可当你感觉四周的墙正在朝你压过来的时候,光有时间什么也治不好。

lines.en: : I need her to feel safe. I need someone to stop those walls from closing in and I’m not strong enough to hold them back on my own.
lines.zh: : 我需要她感到安全。我需要有人来挡住那些正在合拢的墙,而我一个人不够强壮,撑不住它们。

lines.en: : For what it’s worth, I think you are. But fuck it. I’ll give it a shot.
lines.zh: : 不管怎么说,我觉得你够强壮。不过管他呢。我就试一试。

lines.en: : If this doesn’t work though and your daughter just winds up becoming even {i}worse{/i} due to something I said, you owe me free porn forever.
lines.zh: : 但如果这招不灵,而且你女儿因为我说的话变得{i}更糟{/i},那你得欠我一辈子的免费色情片。

lines.en: : That’s so much porn!
lines.zh: : 那可是好多好多色情片!

lines.en: : Yes. I have a problem.
lines.zh: : 是啊。我这是有病。

lines.en: : Okay, fine. But don’t go screwing this up on purpose just to fuel your addiction.
lines.zh: : 好吧,行。但别为了喂饱你的瘾,故意把这事搞砸。

lines.en: So either Makoto cheers up or I get free porn forever. At least I can’t lose anymore.
lines.zh: 所以要么 Makoto 振作起来,要么我拿一辈子免费色情片。至少我不会再输了。

lines.en: : Deal. Pleasure doing business with you.
lines.zh: : 成交。跟你做生意很愉快。

lines.en: : Maybe I’ll even throw in an added bonus of trying to cheer {i}you{/i} up if whatever methods I use on Makoto actually work.
lines.zh: : 也许我还会附赠一个额外福利——如果我用在对 Makoto 身上的那些办法真的管用,我也试着让{i}你{/i}开心开心。

lines.en: scene makidrive22
: Oh, come on...You don’t have to worry about me.
lines.zh: : 哎呀,别这样……你不用为我操心。

lines.en: : I’ve got two close friends who can cheer me up when I need it. You’re here for my daughter.
lines.zh: : 我有两个知心朋友,需要的时候能让我振作起来。你是为了我女儿来的。

lines.en: : I am. But I’m here because {i}you{/i} brought me. Which means that you deserve something too.
lines.zh: : 我是。但我之所以在这儿,是因为{i}你{/i}把我带来了。这意味着你也该得到点什么。

lines.en: scene makidrive23
: Then I’d like to sacrifice my reward for an additional serving of Makoto’s happiness.
lines.zh: : 那我想把我的那份奖励牺牲掉,换成额外一份 Makoto 的幸福。

lines.en: : You know...you’re a pretty great mom for someone who thinks they’re a pretty {i}shitty{/i} mom.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗……对于一个觉得自己是个{i}糟糕{/i}妈妈的人来说,你已经是个相当了不起的妈妈了。

lines.en: : Tell me that again when I don’t feel pressured to rely on a third party to console my daughter because I suck at it.
lines.zh: : 等我不必因为自己太没用、而不得不依赖第三个人来安慰我女儿的时候,再跟我说这话吧。

lines.en: : And then again when I stop being creeped out by how {i}off{/i} she looks when she’s grieving.
lines.zh: : 还有,等我不再被她哀伤时那副「{i}不对劲{/i}」的样子吓到的时候,再说一遍。

lines.en: Wait...
lines.zh: 等等……
